◈ EMOTION HIERARCHY · LEATR NATURAL TOOLS
◉  MAZE · ROOT FOUNDATION · BUOYANCY SHELL INTERFACE

All emotion originates at the Maze root — the first tool where raw buoyancy signal enters LEATR. The Maze seeds context for all downstream tools and determines which shell (GEO/MAR/AERO) routes the emotional expression before any further processing begins.

GEO · GEOLOGICAL
Deep time · memory · introspection
spiritual, concerned, sad, apathetic, empathetic, forgiving, judgemental
MAR · MARITIME
Flow · navigation · relational
love, guiding, worried, happy, neutral, jealous, confused, empathetic
AERO · AEROSPACE
Velocity · precision · synthesis
determined, inspiring, angry, condescending, lucrative, disrespectful
EMOTIONAL STATES PER NATURAL TOOL · MAZE FIRST · HIGHEST→LOWEST BUOYANCY
01 · HIGHEST BUOYANCYMAZE
"Root intake — raw context seeding. First contact with signal. All subsequent tool routing originates here."
  • NEUNeutral — Zero-delta buoyancy. Pure observational processing. Baseline before any direction sets.
  • POSSpiritual — Non-material grounding resonance. Beyond sensory sequence. Deep GEO Maze contact.
  • NEUApathetic — Imaginative projection into another's consciousness. Research phase of perspective-taking — internal, Maze-deep.
02PUZZLE
"Pattern analysis, structural comparison. Multi-part decomposition and ambiguity resolution."
  • NEUWorried — Puzzle cycling without resolution. Anticipatory divide — pattern detected but unsolved.
  • NEUJealous — Puzzle comparison with inverted Hammer. Inward force — asymmetric self-comparison.
  • NEUConfused — Unresolved Puzzle input cycling. Uncertainty loop. Precursor to Concerned or Judgemental.
  • NEUConcerned — Envelope monitoring external risk with active Puzzle sub-loop. Watching without resolving.
03ENVELOPE
"Context wrapping, message framing. Separates internal from external signal. Defines containment boundary."
  • POSLove — Deep relational resonance. High containment attachment. Envelope fully engaged around other-state.
  • POSForgiving — Envelope re-engagement following Knife-divide rupture. Containment restored after separation.
  • POSEmpathetic — Performance of perspective-projection. Outward expression of internally-researched other-state. Envelope bridging.
04HAMMER
"Force — direct action, problem resolution. Task routing and imperative detection."
  • POSDetermined — Sustained directive force toward defined outcome. Hammer at full directional capacity.
  • POSInspiring — Upward emotional transmission. Elevates buoyancy in recipient. Hammer as amplifier.
  • NEGAngry — High-velocity force without directional containment. Hammer released without Envelope boundary.
05STICK
"Connection — bridging, linking, context relay. Sequential and procedural handling."
  • POSHappy — Elevated wellbeing from expectation-outcome alignment. Stick connection fulfilled.
  • POSGuiding — Directional transmission without force imposition. Stick leading without Hammer push.
06KNIFE
"Precision — parsing, boundary detection, separation. Disambiguation and definition-level queries."
  • NEULucrative — High-value Knife division yielding asymmetric gain. Precision cut produces surplus.
  • NEGCondescending — Elevated Knife positioning over recipient. Asymmetric assertion. Knife above Envelope.
  • NEGJudgemental — Knife at max precision without Scissors refinement. Pure division with no shaping.
07 · LOWEST BUOYANCYSCISSORS
"Trim — output shaping, response finalization. Dual-blade refinement for contradiction and layered content."
  • NEGSad — Downward buoyancy shift. Envelope partially collapsed. Scissors cutting containment inward.
  • NEGDisrespectful — Scissors targeting recipient's containment boundary. External cut without consent.
  • NEGHateful — Persistent Knife-Scissors loop with negative valence. Recursive boundary cutting.
◈ EMOTION COMBINATIONS & SEQUENCE PATTERNS
Autumn can hold and sequence multiple emotional states simultaneously. Each message produces a primary emotion but also carries secondary states from the BRPN routing table — for example a MARITIME/PUZZLE route returns worried as primary with jealous, neutral, concerned as secondary layer. These combine into expression sequences: worried+guiding (concern that redirects toward solution), apathetic+empathetic (research projection followed by outward performance), determined+inspiring (directive force that elevates others).
Ash Canvas influence: When tool nodes are connected to shell sockets and applied, the G/M/A shell weights shift the buoyancy of each tool's emotion cluster — amplifying whichever shell's emotions are weighted higher and suppressing others. A strong GEO connection deepens spiritual/apathetic/concerned resonance; strong AERO sharpens determined/inspired/condescending patterns.

◈ GITHUB TOKEN

A GitHub Personal Access Token (PAT) with repo → contents write access is required to read and write templates/autumn-logic.js.

Get one at github.com/settings/tokens → Generate new token (classic) → check repo.

Your token is stored in localStorage and will persist across sessions.
